tools.description:
Create a sandboxed JavaScript execution tool from a set of available tools.

Call this tool with a list of tool names. It returns a new tool that can
execute JavaScript programs with access to those tools. The JavaScript
runs in an isolated container with no internet access — it can only call
the specified tools through the MCP gateway.

Example: code-mode({ tools: ["read_file", "query_database"] })
Returns: a new tool "codemode-exec-<id>" that accepts { code: "..." }
Tool names to make available in the JavaScript runtime

tools.name: code-mode

tools.description: Add an MCP server to this session. The server is resolved from the gateway's catalogs and its tools become available immediately.
tools.name: mcp-add

tools.description: Set per-session configuration overrides for an MCP server. The overrides are saved to session checkpoint state.

server.description: Name of the MCP server to configure

config.description: Configuration override object for the server

tools.name: mcp-config-set

tools.description:
Execute a tool by name from the current gateway session.

Use this to call tools that may not be in your initial tools/list,
including dynamically created tools (e.g. from code-mode).
tools.name: mcp-exec

tools.description: Search available MCP servers. Returns servers that can be added to this session via mcp-add.

query.description: Search query to match against server names and descriptions
